title: Basically Wither Cloak
description: Adds an item close to the wither cloak from hypixel skyblock
body:
## What is this mod about?
**It uses Aster trees to make an invincibility sword**.

## What is the drop of dropping an aster leaf?
**Its close to a 1% chance to drop an aster leaf when breaking aster leaves**.

## Where do i find these "Aster Leaves"
**A new biome called the Aster biome**, it has trees, caves and mineshafts. (No tree saplings)

# Notes:
**_THE TEXTURES WERE MADE BY MY SISTER_**

Mod made in MCreator
